text:
alex wong: Kicking off a staged rollout for model-infer:v2.3 -> start at 10% traffic, +10% every 10m up to 100%. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2026-03-model-infer-v2.3 :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout initiated — model-infer:v2.3 @ 10% traffic. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. AuditID: RL-1767254321
maria t.: Heads-up: seeing a 95p latency bump in eu-west at 10% (~1.7x baseline). Screenshot incoming. :thinking:
prateek: I'm seeing kv-cache miss rate spike correlated with the rollout. qps>200 paths more affected. digging into marshal traces now. If 95p > 1.6x or errors >0.5% we should pause and pin back to v2.2
ops-sre: Agreed. Pause conditions = 95p >1.6x baseline OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for >2min. @alex confirm rollback runbook?
alex wong: Confirmed. Rollback CLI for pin: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run/rollout -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"target":"model-infer:v2.2","mode":"pin","reason":"rollout_pause_1767254321"}'
```
Also manual stop/go criteria: pause on ops-sre signal, then wait 30m green before resuming.
lucy: Infra note — p-prod-8 showing tail CPU increase and some GC spikes. :warning: I recommend pausing at next step rather than pushing to 20%.
maria t.: ops-sre — do you want us to wait for the automated health check at 20% or pause immediately?
ops-sre: Pause now. Initiating manual stop/go: Reason=eu-west 95p 1.8x baseline + error-rate 0.7% (5min window).
prateek: Copy. Starting rollback pin to v2.2 and collecting traces for kv-cache path. I'll attach perf diffs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout PAUSED by ops-sre. Traffic reverted and pinned to model-infer:v2.2. AuditID: RB-2026-1767254321. Notifying oncall.
alex wong: Thanks. I'll open a quick postmortem and update the release notes with the pause + rollback summary. Assigning: @prateek to lead perf root-cause, @maria to run regression evals against the small prompt set.
lucy: Monitoring infra — will confirm when p-prod-8 is stable. ETA for safe re-test ~2h.
prateek: Started flamegraphs + kv-cache profiling. Will post initial findings in this thread.
maria t.: Kicking off perf-runner against v2.3 (low qps) to reproduce. Will attach results.
ops-sre: Creating incident INC-2026-045 to track rollout and metrics. Include timeline and auditID.
alex wong: Good catch everyone. We'll reconvene after prateek/maria findings and before any reattempt. :thumbsup:
